name: Wavelet decomposition
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将信号分解为不同尺度或频带成分的方法。
usage_overview: 用于车辆响应的信号处理，从混合响应中提取低频近似分量，为利用车辆响应研究高速铁路路基长距离沉降阈值提供分析依据。

complete_examples.text: The approximate signal of the car body acceleration signal and SD of I2 signal after the Wavelet decomposition are shown in Figure 14.
The low-frequency components of vehicle responses induced by the additional deformation of rails are extracted by Wavelet decomposition.

P083.title: Study on the long-distance settlement threshold of high-speed railway subgrade based on vehicle responses

contexts.text: 从混合响应中提取低频近似分量，本文采用 db6 小波和12层分解。
